title: Privacy-Preserving Decentralized Federated Learning via Explainable Adaptive Differential Privacy
abstract: arXiv:2509.10691v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Decentralized federated learning enables collaborative model training without a central server, but shared model updates can still leak sensitive information through inversion, reconstruction, and membership inference attacks. Differential privacy offers formal protection, yet existing decentralized methods operate without visibility into the noise already injected by previous participants. Each client therefore adds a full, worst-case perturbation at every step, and the accumulated noise degrades accuracy well below what the privacy requirement actually demands. We present PrivateDFL, a decentralized and privacy-preserving framework that pairs hyperdimensional computing with a transparent noise accountant. The accountant tracks the cumulative perturbation present in the shared model and lets each client add only the minimal incremental noise needed to satisfy its privacy budget. translated_title: 基于可解释自适应差分隐私的隐私保护去中心化联邦学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2509.10691v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：去中心化联邦学习无需中央服务器即可实现协作模型训练，但共享的模型更新仍可能通过反转、重建和成员推断攻击泄露敏感信息。差分隐私提供了形式化保护，然而现有的去中心化方法无法洞察先前参与者已注入的噪声。因此，每个客户端在每一步都添加完整的最坏情况扰动，累积的噪声会将模型精度降低到远低于隐私需求实际要求的水平。我们提出了PrivateDFL，一个去中心化且保护隐私的框架，它将超维计算与透明的噪声核算器相结合。该核算器跟踪共享模型中存在的累积扰动，使每个客户端仅需添加满足其隐私预算所需的最小增量噪声。我们证明了每个传输的模型都满足ε-差分隐私，同时与现有方法相比，模型精度显著提升，通信开销也大幅降低。
tldr: 本文提出PrivateDFL框架，通过透明的噪声核算器动态跟踪累积扰动，使每个客户端仅添加最小增量噪声，从而在满足差分隐私的同时大幅提升模型精度并降低通信开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PrivateDFL, a framework that uses a transparent noise accountant to track cumulative perturbation, enabling each client to add only minimal incremental noise, thereby significantly improving model accuracy and reducing communication overhead while satisfying differential privacy.
